name: node64
description: A JavaScript REPL-first operating system powered by Node.js and Linux

scripts.boot: qemu-system-aarch64 -machine virt -cpu cortex-a72 -m 1024 -kernel "$PWD/boot/vmlinuz" -initrd "$PWD/boot/initramfs.img" -append "console=ttyAMA0 rdinit=/init console=tty1" -device virtio-gpu-pci,xres=1024,yres=768 -device virtio-keyboard-pci -display gtk
scripts.vncserver: qemu-system-aarch64 -machine virt -cpu cortex-a72 -m 1024 -kernel "$PWD/boot/vmlinuz" -initrd "$PWD/boot/initramfs.img" -append "console=ttyAMA0 rdinit=/init console=tty1" -device virtio-gpu-pci,xres=1024,yres=768 -device virtio-keyboard-pci -display vnc=:0
scripts.spice: qemu-system-aarch64 -machine virt -cpu cortex-a72 -m 1024 -kernel "$PWD/boot/vmlinuz" -initrd "$PWD/boot/initramfs.img" -append "console=ttyAMA0 rdinit=/init console=tty1" -device virtio-gpu-pci,xres=1024,yres=768 -device virtio-keyboard-pci -display none -spice addr=127.0.0.1,port=5930,disable-ticketing=on
